message: docopt has to be built from source (its index has only a source distribution), but no-build in pyproject.toml forbids building and depcurfew.json denies it, so installing it fails
fix: Replace docopt with a package that has wheels, or remove "pypi:docopt" from installScripts.deny and add it to installScripts.allow after reviewing it

message: local-lib has to be built from source (it is a local directory), but no-build in pyproject.toml forbids building, so installing it fails until it is allowed
fix: Review local-lib and add "pypi:local-lib" to installScripts.allow in depcurfew.json (it is then always built from source), or replace the package
